cases.question: 每个月的订单量环比增长率是多少？
cases.goldSql:
WITH monthly AS (
  SELECT DATE_TRUNC('month', order_purchase_timestamp) AS m, COUNT(*) AS cnt
  FROM orders GROUP BY 1
)
SELECT m AS month,
       cnt,
       ROUND((cnt - LAG(cnt) OVER (ORDER BY m))::NUMERIC
             / NULLIF(LAG(cnt) OVER (ORDER BY m), 0), 4) AS mom_rate
FROM monthly ORDER BY m
cases.actualSql:
WITH monthly_orders AS (
  SELECT DATE_TRUNC('month', o.order_purchase_timestamp) AS month,
         COUNT(*) AS order_count
  FROM orders o
  GROUP BY 1
), monthly_growth AS (
  SELECT month,
         order_count,
         LAG(order_count) OVER (ORDER BY month) AS prev_order_count
  FROM monthly_orders
)
SELECT month,
       ROUND((order_count - prev_order_count)::numeric / NULLIF(prev_order_count, 0), 4) AS mom_growth_rate
FROM monthly_growth
ORDER BY month
LIMIT 1000
cases.comparisonSql:
SELECT month,mom_rate FROM (WITH monthly AS (
  SELECT DATE_TRUNC('month', order_purchase_timestamp) AS m, COUNT(*) AS cnt
  FROM orders GROUP BY 1
)

FROM monthly ORDER BY m) a

cases.question: 每个会员等级的用户消费总额是多少？
cases.goldSql:
SELECT m.level_id, ROUND(SUM(oi.price), 2) AS sales
FROM orders o
JOIN customers c ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id
JOIN members m ON m.customer_unique_id = c.customer_unique_id
JOIN order_items oi ON oi.order_id = o.order_id
GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1
cases.actualSql:
-- 先按订单汇总商品金额以避免明细放大，再按订单-等级去重关联会员等级
WITH order_amount AS (
  SELECT order_id, SUM(price) AS amt
  FROM order_items
  GROUP BY order_id
),
order_level AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT o.order_id, m.level_id
  FROM orders o
  JOIN customers c ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id
  JOIN members m ON m.customer_unique_id = c.customer_unique_id
)
SELECT ml.level_name, ROUND(SUM(oa.amt), 2) AS total_consumption
FROM order_level ol
JOIN member_levels ml ON ml.level_id = ol.level_id
JOIN order_amount oa ON oa.order_id = ol.order_id
GROUP BY ml.level_name
ORDER BY total_consumption DESC
LIMIT 20

cases.question: 发生过价格变动的商品，按类目统计平均涨跌幅和关联订单数，取订单数前 20。
cases.goldSql:
SELECT p.product_category_name,
       ROUND(AVG(pph.new_price - pph.old_price), 2) AS avg_price_change,
       COUNT(DISTINCT oi.order_id) AS orders
FROM product_price_history pph
JOIN products p ON p.product_id = pph.product_id
JOIN order_items oi ON oi.product_id = pph.product_id
JOIN orders o ON o.order_id = oi.order_id
JOIN customers c ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id
GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY orders DESC LIMIT 20
cases.actualSql:
-- 先按商品汇总价格变动率，再按类目平均；订单数单独按类目去重统计，避免与价格历史明细相乘放大
WITH product_changes AS (
  SELECT h.product_id,
         AVG((h.new_price - h.old_price) / NULLIF(h.old_price, 0)) AS avg_change
  FROM product_price_history h
  GROUP BY h.product_id
),
cat_change AS (
  SELECT p.product_category_name AS category,
         AVG(pc.avg_change) AS avg_change
  FROM product_changes pc
  JOIN products p ON p.product_id = pc.product_id
  WHERE p.product_category_name IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY p.product_category_name
),
cat_orders AS (
  SELECT p.product_category_name AS category,
         COUNT(DISTINCT oi.order_id) AS order_cnt
  FROM order_items oi
  JOIN products p ON p.product_id = oi.product_id
  JOIN product_changes pc ON pc.product_id = p.product_id
  WHERE p.product_category_name IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY p.product_category_name
)

probes.name: absolute_change_preserve_product_weighting
probes.sql:
-- 先按商品汇总价格变动率，再按类目平均；订单数单独按类目去重统计，避免与价格历史明细相乘放大
WITH product_changes AS (
  SELECT h.product_id,
         AVG(h.new_price - h.old_price) AS avg_change
  FROM product_price_history h
  GROUP BY h.product_id
),
cat_change AS (
  SELECT p.product_category_name AS category,
         AVG(pc.avg_change) AS avg_change
  FROM product_changes pc
  JOIN products p ON p.product_id = pc.product_id
  WHERE p.product_category_name IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY p.product_category_name
),
cat_orders AS (
  SELECT p.product_category_name AS category,
         COUNT(DISTINCT oi.order_id) AS order_cnt
  FROM order_items oi
  JOIN products p ON p.product_id = oi.product_id
  JOIN product_changes pc ON pc.product_id = p.product_id
  WHERE p.product_category_name IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY p.product_category_name
)
SELECT cc.category,
       ROUND(cc.avg_change, 2) AS avg_change_rate,
       COALESCE(co.order_cnt, 0) AS order_cnt
FROM cat_change cc
LEFT JOIN cat_orders co ON co.category = cc.category
ORDER BY order_cnt DESC
LIMIT 20

cases.question: 各仓库的库存周转情况：当前库存量、近 90 天出库量、库存周转天数分别是多少？
cases.goldSql:
WITH anchor AS (
  SELECT MAX(moved_at) AS max_ts FROM inventory_movements
),
outbound AS (
  SELECT im.warehouse_id, SUM(im.quantity) AS out_qty
  FROM inventory_movements im, anchor a
  WHERE im.movement_type = 2
    AND im.moved_at > a.max_ts - INTERVAL '90 days'
    AND im.moved_at <= a.max_ts
  GROUP BY 1
),
stock AS (
  SELECT warehouse_id, SUM(quantity) AS stock_qty FROM inventory GROUP BY 1
)
SELECT w.warehouse_name, s.stock_qty, COALESCE(o.out_qty, 0) AS out_qty_90d,
       CASE WHEN COALESCE(o.out_qty, 0) > 0
            THEN ROUND(90.0 * s.stock_qty / o.out_qty, 1) END AS turnover_days
FROM warehouses w
JOIN stock s ON s.warehouse_id = w.warehouse_id
LEFT JOIN outbound o ON o.warehouse_id = w.warehouse_id
ORDER BY turnover_days DESC NULLS LAST

WITH anchor AS (

),
stock AS (
    SELECT warehouse_id, SUM(quantity) AS current_stock
    FROM inventory
    GROUP BY warehouse_id
),
outbound AS (
    SELECT warehouse_id, SUM(quantity) AS out_qty
    FROM inventory_movements
    WHERE movement_type = '2'
      AND moved_at >= (SELECT max_at FROM anchor) - INTERVAL '90 days'
      AND moved_at < (SELECT max_at FROM anchor) + INTERVAL '1 second'
    GROUP BY warehouse_id
)
SELECT w.warehouse_id,
       s.current_stock,
       o.out_qty,
       ROUND(90.0 * s.current_stock / NULLIF(o.out_qty, 0), 1) AS turnover_days
FROM warehouses w
LEFT JOIN stock s ON s.warehouse_id = w.warehouse_id
LEFT JOIN outbound o ON o.warehouse_id = w.warehouse_id
ORDER BY w.warehouse_id
LIMIT 1000
